summary:
This game is an exciting adventure and educational game that takes players on a journey to explore the life of astronauts aboard a space station. In this game, players become astronaut cadets who complete missions and face challenges in the space environment.
Players can explore different areas of the space station and take part in various activities, such as repairing electrical systems, solving technical problems, observing Earth, collecting space debris, growing plants, and exercising in zero gravity. In addition, players must carefully monitor their health, energy, and water levels to survive in space. By completing missions, players can earn experience points, improve their skills, and unlock new challenges.This game is not only an entertaining game but also an educational experience that helps students learn more about space science, technology, and the difficulties astronauts face in their daily lives. Through interactive missions and realistic challenges, the game encourages players to develop problem-solving skills, critical thinking, and creativity. Most importantly, it aims to inspire young students to become curious about the universe and develop a passion for space exploration.
